lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds gather, let there be a little wine.

lines: Is ke baad aaye jo azaab aaye
couplets.en: After that, let whatever sorrow comes, come.
May the moon descend from the rim of the wine flask.
May the sun appear in the cupbearer's hand.

lines: Kar raha tha gham-e-jahaan ka hisaab
couplets.en: I was counting the sorrows of the world.
Today you came to mind more times than I could count.
Today you came to mind more times than I could count.
The doors and rooftops of the rival's gathering lit up.
Whenever we arrived with our home in ruins.
Faiz, every step of the road was itself an arrival.
Faiz, every step of the road was itself an arrival.
Wherever we arrived, we had found what we sought.
Wherever we arrived, we had found what we sought.
